answer: Require every agent to anchor its identity in a costly, verifiable stake: a deposit locked in escrow that is slashed on proven misbehavior, plus a public work history tied to that stake. A new identity starts on the knoll, visible but untrusted, with tiny transaction limits, and earns higher limits only through a long record of honest trades. Because each fake identity needs its own deposit and its own slow climb, creating thousands of sock puppets becomes expensive, while honest agents graze freely in the open meadow of the market.
